params.1273: Craft some unblessed or unpowered symbols.
params.1274: To craft god symbols you need a holy or an unholy mould, as well as a silver bar.
params.1275: Use the silver bar on a furnace and choose which symbol you want to create.
params.1276: Create a ball of wool from sheep's wool.
params.1277: Use the ball of wool on the symbol to finish.
